market.what: US imports of rare-earth compounds and metals (what US coal-REE output would replace); no commercial coal-ash REE sales yet
market.method: USGS MCS 2026 import value; cross-check: US accessible coal ash holds ~$8.4B REE (one-off stock); Ramaco Brook plans 1 kt/yr TREO from ~2028
market.job_what: extraction of REE from coal ash/waste at pilot plants (reagents + processing), US-led; no commercial sales
market.job_method: est.: ~$30M/yr pilot funding (DOE $17M + $10M in 2024, $75M awards 2026 over multi-yr) x ~10% extraction opex share = ~$3M; low confidence

value.logic: coal-REE opex ~$185k/t oxide, 85% reagents (Ramaco PEA). Selective trace-REE extractant cuts reagent use ~10% = $18.5k/t x est. 3 kt/yr US coal-REE output by 2033 = $55M/yr
value.revenue_logic: 50% share of 3 kt TREO x ~$3/kg TREO (fill + make-up + licence)

trend.drivers: NdPr demand +6%/yr; DOE $134M non-traditional REE NOFO (2025) and ~$1B critical minerals program; 45X 10% credit; 63.6 Mt/yr new US coal ash + ~1.9 Bt stored

competition.paper_query: rare earth extraction coal fly ash
competition.notes: Ramaco PEA: Sc+Ga+Ge = 83% of revenue, REE only 17%; an REE-only extractant has limited pull, one that also takes Sc would matter more. Busy academic field, few buyers.

lab.synth: 3-5 step custom: phenanthroline diamide, 3 variants share the core
lab.test: Acid leach of real Class F fly ash (ASTM C618 ash from a utility); D and REE/Fe/Al/Ca selectivity vs D2EHPA at 50-300 mg/L REE; ICP-MS for 15 REE
lab.logic: synth 10 wk ~$30k + test 5 wk: leach work ~$5k, ~150 ICP-MS x $45-70 = ~$9k

sale.gates: testwork with Hazen/Ramaco-type pilot 1 yr; must lock into flowsheet before plant build (~2027-28) or wait for next plant; DOE-funded pilot 1-2 yr
